_comment: Snapshot of the marketplace plugin registry (listings + item rows), emitted by gen_plugins.py. The offline consumers (gen_toolbox_table, gen_capability_map, check_docs_refs) read this instead of the network.

items.name: accounts-oidc
items.description: OIDC/OAuth2 login accounts provider — session-based login via an external identity provider with SSO code hand-back.

items.name: login
items.description: The public /api/login/* login-flow routes.

items.name: accounts-postgres
items.description: Postgres-backed accounts/identity provider — owns user accounts, password login, sessions, and invites.

items.name: login
items.description: The public /api/login/* routes.

items.name: users
items.description: The authed /api/auth/users* user-administration routes.

items.name: deep_agent
items.description: Run a deep agent with planning, subagents, skills, and a filesystem backend.

items.name: refine_agent
items.description: Run an Evaluator-Critic refinement loop until the Critic approves or the budget runs out.

items.name: voting_agent
items.description: Run a voting workflow — voter LLMs answer in parallel, then a judge LLM decides.

items.name: retrieval_tools_agent
items.description: A tools agent that retrieves its tools on demand from a vector store.

items.name: tools_agent
items.description: Run a LangGraph tools agent over tools loaded by name (and optional presets).

items.name: mcp_tools_agent
items.description: Run a LangGraph tools agent whose tools are loaded from an MCP configuration.

items.name: vqa_agent
items.description: Analyze an image and answer a query about it using a multimodal LLM.

items.name: arq
items.description: arq execution backend — background tool runs and schedules over Redis.

items.name: celery
items.description: Celery execution backend — worker/beat/flower runtime, prefork-pool turnover on worker-bus ops, and RedBeat scheduling.

items.name: rq
items.description: RQ execution backend — background tool runs and schedules over Redis.

items.name: slack
items.description: Deliver ask_user questions to a Slack channel and bridge the threaded reply back.

items.name: telegram
items.description: Deliver ask_user questions to a Telegram chat and bridge the typed reply back.

items.name: twilio
items.description: Deliver ask_user questions to a phone over Twilio SMS/WhatsApp and bridge the reply back.

items.name: web
items.description: Deliver ask_user questions to a visitor in the public chat page and bridge the reply back.

items.name: whatsapp
items.description: Deliver ask_user questions to a human on WhatsApp via the Meta Cloud API and bridge the reply back.

items.name: k8s
items.description: Kubernetes ConfigManager backing env via Secrets and manifest via ConfigMaps.

items.name: atlassian
items.description: OAuth connector for Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Compass).

items.name: google
items.description: OAuth connector for Google (Gmail, Calendar, Drive).

items.name: dynamic-postgres-mcp
items.description: Schema-driven generator for safe, scoped PostgreSQL DML tools in FastMCP agent systems

items.name: identity-oidc
items.description: Validate-only OIDC identity provider — resolve an issuer-minted JWT to an authenticated identity.

items.name: redis
items.description: Redis-backed api-key identity provider — validate inbound tokens and provision keys.

items.name: langfuse
items.description: Langfuse monitoring backend — trace/span emission and the observability read surface.

items.name: github
items.description: Storage backend serving text and binary/media content over a GitHub repository.

items.name: local
items.description: Storage backend serving text and binary content from a local directory tree.

items.name: s3
items.description: Storage backend serving text, binary, and media content over an S3 bucket.

items.name: current_time_info
items.description: Return the current time as a structured object.

items.name: generate_embeddings
items.description: Generate embeddings for a single string or a list of strings.

items.name: generate_uuid
items.description: Generate a random UUID (version 4).

items.name: pad_embeddings
items.description: Pad each embedding vector with zeros up to a target dimension.

items.name: request
items.description: Execute an HTTP request through a curl-backed session.

items.name: batch
items.description: Branch a tool into a variant that runs many instances at once.

items.name: cache
items.description: Branch a tool into a variant that memoizes results by call arguments.

items.name: chain
items.description: Branch a tool into a variant that transforms its output and calls a next tool.

items.name: output_schema
items.description: Branch a tool into a variant that forces a configured JSON Schema as its output schema and validates every result against it.

items.name: prometheus_metrics
items.description: Branch a tool into a variant that records a Prometheus call metric.

items.name: proxy
items.description: Branch a tool into a variant that runs the wrapped tool through a proxy.

items.name: create_github_webhook
items.description: Create a repository webhook and return its id, url, events, and active flag.

items.name: list_github_webhooks
items.description: List a repository's webhooks, following Link-header pagination to exhaustion.

items.name: delete_github_webhook
items.description: Delete a repository webhook by id.

items.name: confirm_stripe_payment
items.description: Answer a paid checkout ask from a Stripe webhook event.

items.name: create_stripe_checkout
items.description: Create a Stripe Checkout Session and return its hosted payment URL.

items.name: create_stripe_payment_link
items.description: Create a flexible-amount non-blocking Stripe payment link and return its URL and session id.

items.name: create_stripe_webhook_endpoint
items.description: Create a Stripe webhook endpoint and return its id and one-time signing secret.

items.name: delete_stripe_webhook_endpoint
items.description: Delete a Stripe webhook endpoint by id.

items.name: expire_stripe_checkout
items.description: Expire an open Stripe Checkout Session early and return its id and status.

items.name: list_stripe_webhook_endpoints
items.description: List the account's Stripe webhook endpoints (no signing secrets).

items.name: reconcile_stripe_payments
items.description: Re-answer paid Stripe checkout sessions the webhook path may have lost.

items.name: list_twilio_numbers
items.description: List a Twilio account's incoming phone numbers with their inbound-message webhook.

items.name: get_twilio_number_webhook
items.description: Read one Twilio number's inbound-message webhook URL and method.

items.name: set_twilio_number_webhook
items.description: Set a Twilio number's inbound-message webhook to a given https URL.

items.name: register_whatsapp_template
items.description: Register a WhatsApp message template on the business account and return Graph's id and status.

items.name: list_whatsapp_templates
items.description: List every WhatsApp message template on the business account, following Graph's paging to exhaustion.

items.name: delete_whatsapp_template
items.description: Delete a WhatsApp message template by name and return Graph's response.

items.name: subscribe_whatsapp_app
items.description: Subscribe the app to the business account's webhooks, optionally overriding the callback URI and verify token, and return Graph's response.

items.name: github
items.description: Verify a GitHub webhook delivery's X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC before dispatch.

items.name: stripe
items.description: Verify a Stripe webhook delivery's Stripe-Signature HMAC before dispatch.
